reviews.body:
### 🟢 Approval recommended No active review issues were identified for the Shodan InternetDB rate-limit reporting changes. **No open issues** 🎉
What changed in this PR This PR improves Shodan InternetDB rate-limit reporting for #8398: HTTP 429 responses fail enrichment with a message containing `Retry-After`, without blocking the worker in a retry loop. **Changes:** - Adds a dedicated rate-limit exception that propagates through message processing. - Sets a 30-second request timeout. - Adds tests for rate-limit reporting, exception propagation, other HTTP errors, and timeout configuration. | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | `internal-enrichment/​shodan-internetdb/​tests/​tests_connector/​test_client.py` | Tests rate-limit errors, other HTTP errors, and request timeout. | | `internal-enrichment/​shodan-internetdb/​tests/​test_shodan_internet_db_connector.py` | Tests that rate-limit exceptions propagate from message processing. | | `internal-enrichment/​shodan-internetdb/​src/​shodan_internetdb/​exceptions.py` | Defines the dedicated rate-limit exception. | | `internal-enrichment/​shodan-internetdb/​src/​shodan_internetdb/​client.py` | Adds the request timeout and explicit HTTP 429 handling. |
Review effort: Balanced
